access_boundary.evidence: Only official GEO metadata, supplementary file listings, barcode files, feature files, and antibody/HTO metadata were downloaded and inspected.

held_axis_checks.required_prefix_rule: prefix every held cell identifier with donor_file_id and a colon before union

marker_audit.held_feature_only_catalog_clone_candidat: MS4A1/CD20 catalog 302359 clone 2H7; held feature ID and label are exact, but the catalog is omitted from the held HTO CSV
marker_audit.duplicate_gene_level_candidate: CD45RA and CD45RO both map to PTPRC; lower catalog 304157 CD45RA is frozen and 304255 CD45RO is excluded
marker_audit.source_rna_resolution: each marker resolves exactly once as (rna_symbol,rna_symbol)
marker_audit.held_rna_resolution: each marker resolves exactly once as (held Ensembl ID,rna_symbol)
marker_audit.cd8_resolution: Include CD8A/CD8: source workbook CD8a catalog 301067, sequence GCTGCGCTTTCCATT, clone RPA-T8 exactly maps to held TotalSeq-301067 CD8--RPA-T8-TSA. It is not the separate source CD8/SK1 reagent.
marker_audit.label_schema_resolution: Source workbook duplicate-reagent labels use underscores (CD3_1, CD56_1, CD38_1); deposited source ADT features use hyphens (CD3-1, CD56-1, CD38-1). Exact paired labels are frozen in the candidate designation.
marker_audit.catalog_350231_resolution: Exclude. Source workbook and held HTO metadata identify catalog 350231, sequence GACCTCATTGTGAAT, clone Ber-ACT8 as CD103, but the held feature label is CD57--Ber-ACT8-TSA.

ingestion_blockers_and_rules: Held matrices combine RNA and ADT rows; use the protocol's row-aware two-pass firewall and never describe it as byte-level blindness.
Official metadata do not expose held donor-to-batch membership; do not infer or fabricate batch clusters.
Exclude the redundant global GSE155673_barcodes.tsv.gz file; it is a duplicate of cov01, not another donor.
Prefix held barcodes by donor_file_id before union because 600 unprefixed strings recur across donor files.
Exclude catalog 350231 because the held feature label conflicts with source and held reagent metadata.
Treat the final held HTO CSV record as valid even though the gzip payload lacks a terminal newline; parse records, not physical newline count.
The two GSM records per held donor describe RNA and ADT but point to one combined donor matrix; ingest each physical matrix once per authorized row pass.
required_runner_contract_before_protocol: accept exactly source donors P1-P8 at day0 and exactly held files cov01,cov02,cov03,cov04,cov07,cov08,cov09,cov10,cov11,cov12,cov17,cov18
use calibration P1,P3,P5,P7 and validation components [P2,P4] and [P6,P8]
resolve exactly the 24 frozen one-to-one cognates; retain a marker only if both axes are valid in all eight source donors; apply minimum lock count 16
before held access require the selected primary to beat both the locked classical comparator and untuned raw Poisson strictly within each validation component [P2,P4] and [P6,P8]
after that pass rebuild both marker graphs from all eight source donor profiles for the final all-eight-donor refit
select exactly 384 salted cells per donor
enforce every-marker held modality support in at least 10 of 12 donors and every-donor support ceil(0.8*m^2)
keep every assay SHA null until its authorized stage and enforce the combined-file row firewall
apply alpha 0.0125, the exact full held gate, non-recycling, and one-shot terminal rules
publish tags in the exact frozen sequence before score access
